intro: You have died. Pick a cartridge to be reincarnated into.

games.title: DEEP END
games.text: Deep End. The water is warm. The exit never gets closer.

games.title: SUNROOM LINE
games.text: Sunroom Line. The tram takes you somewhere safe. Leave whenever you're ready.

games.title: VELVET ORCHARD
games.text: Velvet Orchard. Taste your happiest memory. The orchard keeps it forever.

games.title: SIGNAL 03
games.text: Signal zero three. A lost save... or someone else's life?
